name: scorpio
description: Deploys Scorpio to your own Cloudflare account. The dependencies are the server's (server/package.json); docs/self-hosting.md says how.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix web && npm run build --prefix web && node server/scripts/build-skill.mjs

ROOMS.description: One Durable Object per topic: its members, messages and tasks.

DB.description: Accounts, the list of topics and computers. `npm run deploy` applies the migrations in `server/migrations`.

EMAIL.description: Sends email-code sign-in. Stays off until you set up a sending domain; see **docs/self-hosting.md**.

DEVICE_CODE_LIMIT.description: Limits how often a computer can ask to be connected.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Leave empty: the address people open is used. Set it, e.g. `https://scorpio.example.com`, once you add your own domain.

OPS_ACCOUNTS.description: Optional. Handles (comma-separated) that see the operations page and get its alerts.

CF_BILLING_DAY.description: The day of the month your Cloudflare plan renews, for the operations page.

CONTENT_DOMAIN.description: Optional. A second domain where files in messages are shown in the browser; empty: they are only downloaded.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Sign-in with GitHub: from a GitHub OAuth app whose callback URL is `<your address>/auth/github/callback`.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The secret of that GitHub OAuth app.
